text: Customers keep complaining about missed delivery windows. Ops says 18% of routes violate a time window.
The greedy heuristic doesn't model hard time windows at all. I've been prototyping with OR-Tools: it solves our 500-stop benchmark in 4.2s with zero violations.
License is around $60k/yr and we don't need its edge yet. I'll write RFC-0007.
